The '''Scavenger Series Labor and Recycling Droid''' was the result of a project where various underworld groups pooled their results. Gangs of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], [[Scavenger/Legends|scavengers]], and [[Outlaw tech/Legends|outlaw techs]] created a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] series designed to take advantage of the debris and refuse left in the wake of battles during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Using large arms and [[Tractor beam projector/Legends|tractor beam projectors]], the Scavenger Series drew debris and material into its internal break-down chute where it was compacted by [[beam cutter]]s. If the droid encountered debris too big to handle, it would mark the location with [[Transponder beacon/Legends|marker transponders]] for future pickup by its operators. One such droid, [[Bruthus]], worked for the [[Svivreni]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Torsteen]].
